# Daniel Isibor & Co (Chartered Accountants)

> Professional accounting, auditing, and tax advisory practice in Abuja, Nigeria.

## Firm Summary
Daniel Isibor & Co (Chartered Accountants), commonly known as DIC, is an accredited audit and financial consulting firm based in Abuja, Nigeria. The firm is officially registered with the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria (FRC) and the Office of the Auditor General of the Federation. Its partners hold professional qualifications from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN), the Chartered Institute of Taxation of Nigeria (CITN), the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (CIBN), and the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE).

## Core Practice Areas & Services
1. Audit and Assurance Services: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/audit-and-assurance
   - Independent assurance to strengthen financial integrity, corporate governance, and stakeholder confidence.
2. External Audit: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/external-audit
   - Statutory independent audit expressing an expert opinion on financial statements in conformity with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and CAMA 2020.
3. Tax Management and Advisory Services: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/tax-management-and-advisory
   - Strategic corporate and direct tax planning, CIT, VAT, WHT, PAYE, tax health checks, audit defense, and Tax Clearance Certificate (TCC) procurement.
4. Accounting Software Consultancy: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/accounting-software-consultancy
   - Software selection, installation, chart-of-accounts customization, cloud setup, and staff training for QuickBooks, Sage, and ERP systems.
5. Special Purpose Audit: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/special-purpose-audit
   - Focused non-statutory audits, donor grant compliance reviews, forensic accounting, cost efficiency, and due diligence evaluations.
6. Financial Reporting: https://www.danielisiborandco.com/services/financial-reporting
   - Full GAAP & IFRS-compliant compilation of annual accounts, monthly management accounts, cash flow projections, and KPI dashboards.
